summaryFa: در جوانی تجربهٔ دوست بزرگ‌تر؛ سال‌ها بعد شکل‌های تازه با دوست جوان‌تر.
storyFa: آدمک سبزِ جوان کنار دوست آبیِ عینکی خمیر نان را شکل می‌دهد و به پیچ نامنظم آن می‌خندد. سال‌ها بعد همان سبز عینکی و چین‌دار، با دوست صورتیِ جوان نان خرگوشی و ستاره‌ای می‌سازد.
meaningFa: دوستی با نسل‌های دیگر هم تجربه می‌آورد و هم راهی برای بازی و تازگی.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT the attached finished square illustration with the smallest possible change. It has two stacked kitchen scenes. Target ONLY the BLUE friend's face in the TOP scene: this friend is the OLDER ADULT and wears round clear glasses while smiling with closed arc eyes.

Add TWO or THREE fine, short, unobtrusive age-wrinkle/crow's-feet strokes beside the outer eye/upper cheek of this TOP BLUE friend. Use a slightly darker LOCAL BLUE, thin soft hand-painted strokes. Their subtle scale and simplicity should match the few age-wrinkle strokes already beside the BOTTOM OLD GREEN friend's outer eye. Do not draw thick folds or change the circular head silhouette.

Keep every existing feature exactly as it is: top blue smiling arc eyes, glasses, eyebrows, mouth, cheeks, head circle, contact shadow, body, hands, cream apron; ALL other characters, bread, table, kitchen, background, white margins, canvas size, watercolor texture and composition; both Persian headings «جوانی» and «سال‌ها بعد». Add only these tiny age strokes. Do not redraw or restyle any scene, introduce new text, change eye shape, or alter colors.

QA.observed: Root viewed saved edit: top blue now has short age wrinkles; all faces, bodies, aprons, feet, Persian headings and watercolor preserved.

originalGeneration.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create one NEW square 1:1 watercolor book illustration, two spacious scenes stacked vertically, telling friendship across generations through bread making. The supplied approved picture is STYLE ONLY: match the warm simple character drawing, expressive modest dark oval eyes, local-color contours and genuine watercolor. Do not copy its sewing story, yellow character, sewing machine, furniture or text.

Top scene, heading EXACTLY «جوانی»: A YOUNG ADULT GREEN friend on the LEFT and an OLDER ADULT BLUE friend on the RIGHT stand together at a wooden kitchen worktable. Blue wears simple clear glasses and has a few gentle wrinkles. Both wear the SAME simple straight CREAM APRON. Green is shaping an awkward comically crooked pretzel loop from bread dough; blue cheerfully demonstrates shaping another piece, helping as an equal FRIEND. Both laugh kindly at the funny dough shape, sharing the work, not a parent teaching a child. Show adult, capable friends with comparable adult stature.

Bottom scene, heading EXACTLY «سال‌ها بعد»: SAME green character, SAME green color, same head/body proportions, same straight cream apron, same table/kitchen. Green is now an OLDER ADULT with clear glasses and a few small wrinkles. On the RIGHT a YOUNG ADULT PINK friend, with just a few tiny fine SHORT outer-upper eyelashes, wears the IDENTICAL straight cream apron. They invent playful bread shapes TOGETHER. Pink lifts a simple star-shaped cutter from the dough; green actively finishes a little rabbit-shaped loaf. Small star-shaped dough pieces and a tiny rabbit loaf make the new idea visible. Both smile delightedly, equally engaged and capable. This is warm friendship and shared new creativity, not nursing care.

Sparse purposeful kitchen, flour bowl and small rolling pin, consistent wooden table and pale floor, minimal background. ALL figures' bodies and BOTH feet, every table leg, whole table, bowls/cutters and important props fully INSIDE each scene. Keep table narrow enough to see each friend's feet clearly. Clean generous white paper margins on ALL edges and a white gap between scenes. No borders, edge crop or paint reaching file edges.

STRICT design: heads PERFECT CIRCLES with no oval, jaw, chin or flattened lower arc. No hair, noses, ears or necks; heads directly join shoulders with a soft local-color crescent contact shadow. Medium ADULT proportions, no children. Neutral torso with almost parallel sides: no breasts, pinched waist, wide hips/buttocks or gendered bulges/notches. Aprons straight, ungendered. Small DARK oval eyes, optional tiny INSIDE glint, NO white sclera; pink keeps SAME eye shape/size plus few short lashes. Each visible hand exactly THREE fingers and ONE thumb; natural dough/cutter grip and occlusion allowed.

Genuine MODERATE translucent layered hand-painted watercolor visible INSIDE heads, torsos, limbs and hands as well as setting. Broad irregular overlapping washes, luminous paper, varied pigment density, subtle pooling; darker local-color outlines, never black body contours. Avoid flat/vector, marker, uniform pencil grain, glossy 3D or heavy mottling. Only the two headings in accurate connected RTL Persian. No English, dialogue, labels or age numbers.
